policy: Change detection only, not semantic equivalence. A bare digest refresh is not a valid disposition; review both modes and update the per-pair rationale. No wall-clock production or CI action.

ON pages and classifies pending work; OFF preserves historical unpaged ordering and payload, checked by the independent generator oracle. These shared attention/database changes are not the token-savings switch; getPendingQuestions pagination and the ON/OFF bootstrap generator implementations are unchanged by that diff. The legacy generator fixture remains pinned; this refresh accepts only the reviewed shared db.ts dependency bytes.
